topicA: AI's Impact on Marketing Accountability and Operations
topicB: B2B SEO Case Studies and Strategy

recap.intro: This week you explored two areas of B2B marketing: how AI is changing marketing operations and accountability, and the power of B2B SEO strategies through real-world case studies.
bullets: AI tools can simplify complex tasks for sales teams, but also introduce new challenges like unexpected changes to marketing campaigns.
Successful B2B SEO relies on understanding what customers search for and creating valuable content that answers their questions.
Measuring the true success of AI in business means looking at real improvements, not just how often it's used, and being aware of complex pricing models.
Even great products need strong online visibility, and strategies like link building help search engines see your website as trustworthy.
recap.closing: This week you learned that while technology like AI and SEO offers powerful tools, strategic planning and human oversight are essential for true B2B marketing success.
